'''R4-G7''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] assigned to [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], around the time of the [[Battle of Mindor]]. Klivian called him "Arfour."

==Biography==
R4-G7 was damaged in an engagement around the ersatz ''[[Corellian Queen]]''. Roughly half of his turret dome was destroyed during the dogfight.
